conflicting_value_spread_distribution.population: conflicting duplicate keys with finite max(Value) - min(Value)

definitions.record: Phase 1 parsed (Time, DeviceId, Sensor, Value); numeric equality, no tolerance
definitions.multiplicity: counts compared per complete record, without deduplication
definitions.nan: NaN never matches, including another NaN; exported unmatched on each side
definitions.infinity: same-sign infinities match exactly and remain explicitly counted
definitions.invalid_rows: excluded from numeric matching, counted explicitly; prevent complete verification
definitions.provenance: all occurrences per side, not arbitrary attribution of identical excess rows

definitions.temperature_rows: Phase 1 schema-valid temperature rows before deduplication
definitions.duplicate_rows: sum(multiplicity - 1); first occurrence is retained by Phase 1
definitions.identical_values: exact parsed-float equality, no tolerance; NaN is never equal
definitions.value_difference: max(Value) - min(Value) per conflicting key; mean is unweighted
definitions.nonfinite_values: accepted as in Phase 1; undefined spreads excluded and counted
definitions.zero_denominator: percentages and differences with no applicable keys are null
definitions.cross_file_excess_rows: sum(distinct source files - 1) per duplicated key
definitions.within_file_excess_rows: sum(multiplicity - distinct source files) per duplicated key
definitions.primarily: strictly more than 50 percent, assessed by keys and excess rows
definitions.example_order: descending spread, then Time and DeviceId; undefined spreads last
definitions.row_number: CSV record number including header as record 1
